content: Vercel Cron Jobs on Hobby: up to 100 cron jobs per project allowed, but each can run at most once per day (cron expressions more frequent than daily fail deployment); exact trigger time within the specified hour is not guaranteed (load distribution). For more frequent reminder checks, must call the API route from an external scheduler (e.g. GitHub Actions, cron-job.org) or run daily and check due-dates in a wider window.
